title: Suggestions view: table layout + column definitions + filter chips (batching/caching beta)
creator: Tessa Morgan
description: Define the Suggestions list/table information architecture for the beta: the table layout, column definitions (savings, risk, confidence), sorting behavior, and filter chip patterns. Scope is explicitly batching + caching suggestions only.
content:
Context
- This ticket defines the list/table experience for the Optimization Suggestions beta in the Redwood Console (batching + caching only).
- Primary users: platform/ML engineers responsible for inference cost + latency SLOs.
- The list needs to make opportunities comparable at a glance (savings vs latency impact vs risk), while being conservative and transparent (estimated, not guaranteed).

Source docs / links
- PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/optimization-suggestions-console-ux-beta-prd.json
- Information architecture + user flows: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/suggestions-view-information-architecture-and-user-flows.json
- Risk definitions + copy: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/risk-level-definition-and-copy-guidelines.json (see DES-640 for the badge)
- Empty states/onboarding: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/suggestions-empty-states-and-onboarding.json
- API contract/stable IDs (for table pagination + sorting): sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-suggestions-api-contract-and-stable-ids.json

Goals for the table
1) Comparable scanning: users can quickly find “big wins” and understand trade-offs.
2) Trust: avoid overprecision; show estimates with clear assumptions and confidence; keep risk semantics about performance/reliability (not security).
3) Action path: every row should lead to details (drawer) and “how to apply” next steps.
4) Fast + accessible: supports large orgs/routes; keyboard nav; screen-reader friendly; doesn’t rely on color alone.

Non-goals
- Not implementing quantization suggestions in this view.
- Not implementing auto-apply. “Apply” remains a guided CTA that deep-links to config/rollout pages.

Proposed table layout (v0)
Placement
- Console nav: Optimize → Suggestions (beta flag gated).
- Page header includes org/project context switcher (if applicable) + optional environment selector when present in console.

Table structure
- Sticky header row; scrollable body.
- Row click opens details drawer (DES-627). Explicit “Open” icon button also present for accessibility.
- First column left-aligned and “sticky” when horizontal scrolling.

Columns (left → right)
1) Suggestion (primary)
   - Title: “Enable continuous batching” or “Increase batch window” / “Enable prefix cache” / “Increase cache TTL” (exact copy finalized in DES-627).
   - Subtitle: route + model short label (e.g., “/v1/chat/completions · llama-3.1-70b-instruct”).
   - Suggestion type pill: Batching | Caching.

2) Est. savings
   - Display: “$X/day” (primary) with “Y%” secondary.
   - Tooltip text: “Estimated savings based on last 7 days of traffic. Not a guarantee.” + link to “How estimates work”.
   - Formatting rules:
     - Use rounded values: $/day with 0–1 decimals depending on magnitude (>$100/day: integer; $10–$100/day: 1 decimal; <$10/day: 2 decimals).
     - Use em dash when missing/insufficient telemetry.

3) Latency impact
   - Display: “p95 +Z ms” (primary) and “p50 +W ms” (secondary) to keep the focus on tail latency.
   - When a suggestion is expected to reduce latency (rare for these), show “p95 −Z ms” but keep neutral styling (no “green win” semantics in beta).
   - Tooltip: clarify that deltas are estimated and depend on traffic shape/concurrency; “Risk” incorporates uncertainty + guardrails.

4) Risk
   - Risk badge: Low | Medium | High (visual system in DES-640).
   - Tooltip content (1–2 sentences) summarizing why the risk is that level, based on top 1–2 drivers (e.g., “This route has strict p95 SLO and low concurrency headroom”).
   - Important: do not use “safe/unsafe” language; avoid implying security risk.

5) Confidence
   - Values: High | Medium | Low.
   - Tooltip: explain confidence drivers (data volume, stability, variance). Avoid exposing raw model coefficients; keep it user-facing.
   - Design note: confidence is distinct from risk. Risk is “expected impact + failure modes”; confidence is “how sure we are about the estimate.”

6) Scope (route/model)
   - Compact text column for scanning and filtering validation:
     - Route name (canonical) and model display name.
   - This column can be hidden in narrower layouts if suggestion column already includes it; see responsive behavior below.

7) Last updated
   - Display relative time: “2h ago”, “Yesterday”, “6d ago”.
   - If stale: show “Stale” tag (neutral) and surface “as of <timestamp>” in tooltip.

Row-level affordances
- Chevron/open icon on hover/focus to indicate “opens details”.
- Overflow menu (kebab) with:
  - Dismiss suggestion (requires permission).
  - Copy link (deep link includes stable suggestion ID).
  - View docs.

Default sorting
- Default: Est. savings ($/day) descending.
- Secondary sort: Risk ascending (Low before Medium before High) for identical savings.
- User-selectable sorts:
  - Est. savings (desc/asc)
  - Latency impact p95 (asc/desc)
  - Risk (Low → High / High → Low)
  - Confidence (High → Low)
  - Last updated (newest first)

Pagination
- Server-side pagination per ADR (cursor-based). Page size 25 (align with API performance budget); allow 50 as an option if console pattern supports it.
- Keep current filters/sort in URL query params for shareability and back button behavior.

Filter chip system (top of table)
Pattern
- Always-visible filter row above the table header.
- Filter chips show active state and can be cleared individually.
- A “Clear all” action appears when 2+ filters applied.
- A “More filters” button opens a right-side popover/inline panel (avoid modal) for overflow filters.

Filters (v0)
1) Suggestion type
   - Multi-select: Batching, Caching.
   - Default: both selected (no chip shown until user changes).

2) Risk
   - Multi-select: Low, Medium, High.
   - Chip shows: “Risk: Low, Medium” (truncate to “Risk: 2 selected” when >2).

3) Confidence
   - Multi-select: High, Medium, Low.

4) Route
   - Searchable multi-select dropdown (typeahead).
   - Chip shows first selection + “+N”.

5) Model
   - Searchable multi-select dropdown.
   - Consider grouping by model family in the dropdown if available; display remains model name.

6) Region (optional / only if exposed in console context)
   - Multi-select.
   - Only show if suggestions API supports region scoping and the org has multi-region traffic.

7) Status (beta)
   - Default: Active.
   - Optional toggles: “Include dismissed” / “Include applied” depends on backend availability. If not supported in v0, hide.

Search
- A lightweight search box that matches route + model + suggestion title (client-side string match over returned rows is acceptable for v0, but should not claim it searches all data if pagination is server-side).

Responsive behavior
- At narrow widths:
  - Merge “Scope” into Suggestion column subtitle; hide Scope column.
  - Collapse “Last updated” into a small clock icon with tooltip.
  - Keep Savings, Risk visible as core decision columns.

A11y + interaction notes
- Keyboard:
  - Tab focuses filter controls → table header sort controls → table rows.
  - Enter/Space on a focused row opens details drawer.
- Screen reader:
  - Row has accessible name: “Suggestion <title>, Savings <value>, Latency impact <value>, Risk <value>, Confidence <value>.”
  - Tooltips must be accessible (aria-describedby) and not hover-only.
- Color:
  - Risk badge must pass contrast requirements and not rely only on hue; include label text.

Copy guidance (table-level)
- Page subheader (under title): “Suggestions are generated from recent traffic and are estimates—not guarantees.”
- Hover tooltips use consistent phrasing:
  - “Estimated” not “projected guaranteed”.
  - “Risk is about performance/reliability impact and uncertainty.”

Edge cases
- Insufficient telemetry:
  - Table renders but shows empty state (handled in DES-655) with setup CTA.
  - If some rows have missing fields, show em dash and a tooltip “Not enough data for this metric yet.”
- Mixed units:
  - Savings shown in org billing currency; if unknown, default “$” (confirm with PM).
- Staleness:
  - If stale_as_of > 24h (threshold per backend), show “Stale” tag; still sortable but warns in tooltip.

Acceptance criteria
- Column set is agreed by Design + PM (Marissa/Aditya) and feasible per API contract.
- Filter list is implemented in the console design system patterns (chips + dropdowns) and matches expected backend capabilities.
- Sorting rules are defined, including default.
- A11y requirements documented (keyboard + screen reader + contrast constraints).
- Responsive rules documented.

Open questions
1) Should latency impact show both p50 and p95, or only p95 to reduce cognitive load?
   - Recommendation: show p95 primary + p50 secondary (keeps trust; aligns with SLO discussions).
2) Do we need “Traffic coverage” (e.g., % of requests impacted) as a v0 column?
   - Recommendation: no column in list; include in drawer details to avoid widening table.
3) Should Savings show confidence interval (e.g., “$120–$180/day”)?
   - Recommendation: not in list for v0; reserve for drawer to keep table scannable.

Next steps
- Handoff to ENG-19358 (console UI) with annotated layout + column specs.
- Coordinate with DES-640 (risk badge) and DES-627 (details drawer explanations + assumptions).
- Validate filter feasibility with ENG-19341 (API sorting/filtering) and ADR constraints; if any filters are client-only in v0, ensure copy doesn’t overpromise.

Design artifacts
- Wireframe references: sources/google_drive/agents.md (Suggestions table variants A/B; selected B with sticky Savings + Risk columns)
- Accessibility notes: sources/linear/design/suggestions-risk-badge-visual-exploration.json (risk badge contrast + iconography)
comments: 2026-01-22 (Kenji Nakamura): Drafted initial column set: Suggestion, Savings, Latency impact, Risk, Confidence, Route/Model, Last updated. Added note that p95 should be primary for latency deltas.

2026-01-24 (Tessa Morgan): +1 on keeping list scannable. Please keep confidence separate from risk to avoid “High risk = low confidence” confusion. Also ensure we have a path for “stale estimate” messaging.
2026-01-28 (Marissa Cole): PM review: default sort must be savings ($/day) desc. Add filter chips for Type (batching/caching) and Risk. Model/Route filters are important for platform teams.
2026-01-29 (Aditya Rao): For v0, confidence should be a 3-level label with tooltip, not numeric. Also avoid showing any implied guarantees in the list view; assumptions belong in the drawer/docs.
2026-02-03 (Alicia Perez): A11y reminder: don’t rely on hover-only tooltips; make sure badge + tooltips are keyboard accessible and contrast-safe.

2026-02-06 (Chloe Martin): Backend note: server-side pagination is cursor-based; we can support sorting by savings and updated_at in v0. Filtering by risk/type is straightforward; route/model filter may need typeahead backed by separate endpoints or client-side over current page only—flagging for ENG-19341.

2026-02-07 (Kenji Nakamura): Updated spec: clarified search limitations with server-side pagination; moved any “coverage %” to details drawer. Added responsive behavior (merge scope into primary column).
2026-02-12 (Dylan Brooks): Eng review: table layout works; will implement sticky first column + sticky header. Need final column names/copy and which filters are server-backed for beta.
2026-02-14 (Tessa Morgan): Marking Done. Handoff complete for ENG-19358. Any changes to risk badge visuals should go through DES-640; drawer content through DES-627.
